name: Portofino Wine & Cocktail Bar
h1: Wine, cocktails and *Italian small bites downtown.*
lead: Charcuterie, tartare and live music on weekends on Washington Avenue, next to Damiano's through a shared garden.
about: Portofino opened in August 2026 at 208 W Washington Ave. Blake Zeitman, who also owns Damiano's Cucina Italiana next door, connected the two with a shared garden.
It pours wine, beer and full cocktails with Italian-inspired small bites, and has a deck, a big-screen TV and live music on weekends.
services: Wine, beer and a full cocktail menu.
